description:
Fetch a GeoJSON boundary polygon for a country, city, or region. Returns simplified GeoJSON ready to use as the 'boundary' prop in the Map composition.

mainlandOnly excludes small islands and overseas territories (e.g. Corsica for France, Hawaii for USA).

mainlandOnly.description: Keep only the largest landmass, excluding small islands and overseas territories

maxPoints.description: Maximum points per polygon ring for simplification (default 500, lower = smaller payload)

type.description: Type of place to search for

name: clipform_fetch_boundary

geojson.description: The Feature GeoJSON as a JSON string - use as the boundary prop in the Map composition

size_kb.description: Approximate size of the returned GeoJSON in KB

title: Fetch Geographic Boundary
